about: Golden entries of converter/golden/dbt-ls.json that are not a plain match of the engine on the entry's tag, with the reason. Written by the selection-engine agent; the golden file itself is not edited. Verdicts: other-state = valid output recorded at the previous/next tag (the engine reproduces it there); not-reproducible = recorded in a temporary state of the chapter (demo edits, deleted models...), the engine equals real dbt at the tag; golden-invalid = the entry's expected lines are not a dbt ls output; out-of-scope = dbt stops before node selection or the project state has no DAG; not-simulated = a state-dependent entry whose --state folder cannot be rebuilt from the data.
